hero.title: Solutions Built Around Your Business
hero.description: Connection Pilot helps businesses respond faster, capture more customer inquiries, and create a more seamless communication experience.

missedCalls.title: Turn Missed Calls Into Opportunities
missedCalls.description: When your team is busy, after hours, or helping another customer, a missed call does not have to become a lost conversation. Connection Pilot can send a helpful text so customers can share what they need and your team has the context to follow up.

aiConversations.title: Give Customers Answers When They Need Them
aiConversations.description: Connection Pilot can guide common customer conversations, collect the details that matter, and make it easy to bring in a team member when a human touch is needed.
aiConversations.controlNote: Your business stays in control. Conversations can be escalated to a human whenever they need more attention.

leadCapture.title: Keep Every Customer Inquiry Organized
leadCapture.description: Connection Pilot can turn the useful details from customer conversations into an organized lead view, so your team has context without manually recording every inquiry.

followUps.title: Stay Connected After the First Conversation
followUps.description: Keep conversations moving with thoughtful communication throughout the customer journey. Connection Pilot helps your team stay present without suggesting that any appointment is automatically booked.

unified.title: Bring Customer Communication Together
unified.description: Connection Pilot is designed to connect customer conversations with your workflow, so useful information does not stay scattered across different tools.
